verdict.rationale: Linear's Initiatives feature (grouping multiple projects under a lead team, with status like proposed/canceled and priority) points toward portfolio-style organization, but the evidence never explicitly describes progress roll-up (e.g., aggregated completion percentages or a dedicated portfolio dashboard) across projects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of progress aggregation/visualization across projects, independent/hands-on confirmation of a portfolio view, and any reporting-specific UI details beyond initiative metadata.
